messages:
kiran: heads up - running csv->tablex perf/accuracy tests on the new AWQ-int8 build. seeing repeated 'column collapse' on multi-column CSVs where columns B/C look merged into one token stream. repro below.

maya: can you paste a minimal repro and the exact model + quant config?

kiran: model: rdx-13b-awq-int8-qv2, quant-config: awq_v2, batch=1, seq=1024. Minimal repro file (test.csv):
```
id,question,answer
1,"Name,Age,City","Alice,30,Seattle"
2,"Name,Occupation","Bob,Engineer"
```
Pipeline used: `python tools/csv_to_tablex.py --model rdx-13b-awq-int8-qv2 --in test.csv --out out.json`

sam: can repro locally on latest AWQ-int8 wheel. Looks like tokenizer merges comma tokens inside quoted fields into adjacent column tokens when AWQ bucket_size=32. investigating tokenizer->align step. :eyes:

olivia: do we have quick regression numbers vs fp8/gptq? need to know severity for onboarding.

eval-bot: quick eval summary (tablex-multicol suite): AWQ-int8 delta vs FP16 baseline: exact-match -5.6%, GPTQ-int8 delta -1.2%, FP8 delta -0.3%. (run id: 2026-03-19-021)

kiran: thanks — note this reproduces only on rows with quoted fields containing commas or stray linebreaks. suspect preprocess escaping is stripped before tokenization.

maya: can you dump token ids for the problematic cell? helps narrow whether it's tokenizer or model runtime.

kiran: pasted token ids for cell "Alice,30,Seattle":
```
Cell tokens: [1012, 450, 2001, 6, 7, 44, 890]
Expected boundary token (11) between age and city missing; sequence shows merging at index 5
```

sam: rolling a quick patch that preserves CSV quoting escape tokens through tokenization. also testing different AWQ bucket_size. will run sweep over awq/gptq/fp8 and post numbers here.

ci-bot: scheduled job: quant-sweep/2187654321 started. logs: https://ci.redwood/quant-sweeps/2187654321

sam: initial results (tablex-multicol): AWQ-int8 bucket=32 -> failure rate 18% (exact-match drop), AWQ-int8 bucket=16 -> 3.2%, GPTQ-int8 -> 1.8%, FP8 -> 0.2%.

olivia: large sensitivity to bucket size — points at kernel/kv packing interaction with token boundaries rather than pure quant noise. could be sequence packing or KV-cache granularity.

kiran: proposal: short-term normalize CSV quoting before tokenization to avoid ambiguous tokens. medium-term: add token-boundary checks in quant runtime and a unit test for quoted CSV cases. also add failing rows to onboarding eval.

maya: agree. can we add a canary to onboarding that runs tablex-multicol on every new quantized candidate? makes regressions visible early.

sam: will open two PRs: 1) csv-preprocess-hotfix (normalization) 2) quant-runtime token-boundary check + test. assigning both to me, ETA: tomorrow morning. referencing ML-1247.

kiran: perfect, thanks :thumbsup: I'll upload failing examples to the eval corpus and add a note on the onboarding checklist.

olivia: pls ping when PR merged so we can unblock bring-ups.

sam: will do — updating this thread with CI links & final numbers once sweep completes.
